systems.headline: From brief to production.
systems.subtext: Clarity first. Architecture second. Then ship.

step1.title: Discovery & scope
step1.desc: I define the problem, user flows, and success criteria — then the smallest version that ships value.

step2.title: Architecture & data design
step2.desc: API contracts, data models, auth, and service boundaries defined before a line of implementation is written.

step3.title: Build & iterate
step3.desc: Thin vertical slices from UI to API to data. Clean components, predictable state, readable code.

step4.title: Testing, docs & QA
step4.desc: Swagger docs, edge case coverage, and validation before every release. Stable code builds trust.

step5.title: Deployment & hosting
step5.desc: Containerized services, automated deployments, monitoring. The system stays healthy after launch.
